title: Option to run script after item is done
description: It would be useful to be able to check a box to have a configured script to be run, like a deploy, after a specific item is done.
plan: # Implementation Plan: Option to Run Script After Item Completion This plan implements the ability to select a script that runs automatically when an item is approved from final-human-approval and moved to done. ## Section 1: Core Data Model Changes ### 1.1 Add done_script Field to FeatureFile **File:** `pipeline/state.py` - Add `done_script` property and setter to FeatureFile class: ```python @property def done_script(self) -> str: return self._data.get("done_script", "") def set_done_script(self, script_id: str) -> None: self._data["done_script"] = script_id self._save() ``` - Update `FeatureFile.create()` method signature (fix return type hint): ```python def create(board: str, title: str, description: str = "", item_type: str = "feature", done_script: str = "") -> FeatureFile: ``` - Add `done_script` to initial data dictionary in create() method: ```python data = { # ... existing fields ... "done_script": done_script, } ``` - **Validation**: Add script validation in setter - check if script_id exists in scripts.json, log warning if not found but don't fail (allow empty string) ## Section 2: Script Execution Engine ### 2.1 Create Script Execution Function **File:** `pipeline/scripts.py` - Add new function `execute_done_script()`: ```python def execute_done_script(feature, config: Config) -> None: """Execute the done script for a feature if configured.""" if not feature.done_script: return scripts = load_scripts(config.mad_dir) script = next((s for s in scripts if s.id == feature.done_script), None) if not script: log.warning(f"Done script '{feature.done_script}' not found in scripts.json") return # Create script status for tracking status = ScriptStatus(script_id=script.id) # Run in background thread (fire-and-forget) import threading def run_in_background(): context = f"Triggered by completion of {feature.item_type}: {feature.title}" try: run_script(script, config, status, context) log.info(f"Done script '{script.id}' completed for feature {feature.id}") except Exception as e: log.error(f"Done script '{script.id}' failed for feature {feature.id}: {e}") thread = threading.Thread(target=run_in_background, daemon=True) thread.start() ``` - **Threading Details**: Use `threading.Thread` with `daemon=True` for fire-and-forget execution that doesn't block the approval flow - **Validation**: Re-validate script exists at execution time, handle gracefully if deleted - **Logging**: Log script execution start/completion/errors with feature context ## Section 3: CLI Integration ### 3.1 Update Pipeline Done Command **File:** `pipeline/pipeline.py` - Import and call script execution in `done()` function: ```python def done(feature_id: str): # ... existing code ... feature.move_to_stage("done") # Execute done script if configured from scripts import execute_done_script try: execute_done_script(feature, get_config()) except Exception as e: console.print(f"[yellow]Warning:[/yellow] Done script execution failed: {e}") # ... rest of existing code ... ``` - **Error Handling**: Script execution failures should not prevent the done operation from completing ## Section 4: TUI Integration ### 4.1 Add Script Selection During Feature Creation **File:** `pipeline/tui.py` - Find the feature creation flow (likely in a create/new feature function) - Add script selection step after item type selection: ```python # Load available scripts scripts = load_scripts(config.mad_dir) script_choices = [("(none)", "")] + [(f"{s.label}", s.id) for s in scripts] done_script = questionary.select( "Select script to run when item is completed (optional):", choices=script_choices ).ask() # Pass to FeatureFile.create() feature = FeatureFile.create(board, title, description, item_type, done_script) ``` ### 4.2 Display done_script in Feature Views **File:** `pipeline/tui.py` - Find feature info/inspect display functions - Add done_script display similar to design_ref: ```python if feature.done_script: scripts = load_scripts(config.mad_dir) script = next((s for s in scripts if s.id == feature.done_script), None) script_label = script.label if script else f"[MISSING] {feature.done_script}" console.print(f"Done Script: {script_label}") ``` ### 4.3 Allow Editing done_script - Add done_script editing option to feature edit menu: ```python choices.append("Edit done script") # In edit handler: if action == "Edit done script": scripts = load_scripts(config.mad_dir) current_label = "(none)" if feature.done_script: current_script = next((s for s in scripts if s.id == feature.done_script), None) current_label = current_script.label if current_script else f"[MISSING] {feature.done_script}" script_choices = [("(none)", "")] + [(f"{s.label}", s.id) for s in scripts] new_script = questionary.select( f"Current done script: {current_label}\nSelect new done script:", choices=script_choices ).ask() if new_script is not None: feature.set_done_script(new_script) ``` ## Section 5: Web UI Integration ### 5.1 Add Script Selection to Creation Form **File:** `server/templates/` (relevant template files) - Add script selection dropdown to feature creation forms: ```html ``` **File:** `server/api.go` - Update feature creation endpoint to handle done_script parameter - Pass scripts list to templates: ```go scripts := loadScripts() // implement this function templateData := map[string]interface{}{ "Scripts": scripts, // ... other data ... } ``` ### 5.2 Display done_script on Feature Cards - Add done_script display to feature list/detail views: ```html {{if .DoneScript}} 📋 {{.DoneScriptLabel}} {{end}} ``` ### 5.3 Allow Editing done_script - Add done_script field to feature edit modal/form - Update edit endpoint to handle done_script changes ## Section 6: Backend API Updates ### 6.1 Update Go Server Structure **File:** `server/api.go` - Add DoneScript field to Feature struct: ```go type Feature struct { // ... existing fields ... DoneScript string `json:"done_script"` } ``` - Update feature creation/update endpoints to handle done_script - Add scripts loading function to serve script list to frontend ### 6.2 Add Scripts API Endpoint - Create endpoint to serve available scripts: ```go func handleScripts(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { scripts := loadScripts() json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(scripts) } ``` ## Section 7: UI/UX Considerations ### 7.1 Mobile Responsiveness - Ensure script selection dropdown works well on mobile devices - Test script labels don't overflow on narrow screens ### 7.2 User Feedback - Show visual indicator (icon/badge) when a feature has a done script configured - Provide clear labeling: "Run after completion" or similar ## Section 8: Testing ### 8.1 Unit Tests - Test FeatureFile.done_script property and setter - Test execute_done_script() function with various scenarios: - Valid script execution - Missing script handling - Script execution errors ### 8.2 Integration Tests - Test complete flow: create feature with script → approve → verify script runs - Test script validation during feature creation - Test editing done_script on existing features ### 8.3 Edge Case Testing - Feature with done_script where script is later deleted from scripts.json - Multiple features completing simultaneously with different scripts - Script execution failures don't block done operation ## Section 9: Validation & Error Handling ### 9.1 Creation Time Validation - In FeatureFile.create() and set_done_script(): validate script exists in scripts.json - Log warning but allow creation/update if script not found (graceful degradation) ### 9.2 Execution Time Validation - In execute_done_script(): re-validate script exists before execution - Handle missing scripts gracefully with appropriate logging ### 9.3 Thread Safety - Script execution in background thread won't interfere with main pipeline operations - Use daemon threads to ensure clean shutdown ## Section 10: Documentation Updates ### 10.1 User Documentation - Update help text to explain done script functionality - Document how to configure scripts in scripts.json ### 10.2 Developer Documentation - Document the done_script field in FeatureFile schema - Document the script execution flow and threading model ## Implementation Order 1. **Core Data Model** (Section 1) - Foundation for all other changes 2. **Script Execution Engine** (Section 2) - Core functionality 3. **CLI Integration** (Section 3) - Enable command-line usage 4. **TUI Integration** (Section 4) - Terminal interface 5. **Backend API Updates** (Section 6) - Support for web interface 6. **Web UI Integration** (Section 5) - Frontend interface 7. **Testing** (Section 8) - Verify functionality 8. **Documentation** (Section 10) - User and developer guides This plan addresses all previous review feedback including CLI integration, feature display in both TUI and Web UI, proper validation timing, edge cases, threading details, and the return type fix.

test_spec:
# Test Specification: Option to Run Script After Item Is Done

## 1. Behaviors That MUST Be Verified

### 1.1 Data Model — done_script Field on FeatureFile (state.py)

**Behavior:** FeatureFile has a `done_script` property that returns the stored script ID or empty string by default.
- Create a FeatureFile without specifying done_script. The `done_script` property should return `""`.
- Create a FeatureFile with `done_script="deploy-prod"`. The `done_script` property should return `"deploy-prod"`.
- The done_script value should be persisted in the JSON file on disk.

**Behavior:** `set_done_script()` updates the done_script value and persists it.
- Call `feature.set_done_script("run-tests")`. Reading the JSON file from disk should show `"done_script": "run-tests"`.
- Call `feature.set_done_script("")` to clear it. The property should return `""`.
- After calling `set_done_script()`, re-loading the FeatureFile from the same path should reflect the new value.

**Behavior:** `FeatureFile.create()` accepts an optional `done_script` parameter.
- `FeatureFile.create(board, title, desc, "feature", done_script="my-script")` should produce a JSON file containing `"done_script": "my-script"`.
- `FeatureFile.create(board, title, desc)` (without done_script) should produce a JSON file containing `"done_script": ""`.

**Behavior:** Validation in `set_done_script()` — warns if script ID not found in scripts.json but does not fail.
- Call `set_done_script("nonexistent-script")` when scripts.json has no matching entry. The setter should succeed (value is stored) but a warning should be logged.
- Call `set_done_script("")` — should always succeed without warning.

### 1.2 Script Execution Engine — execute_done_script() (scripts.py)

**Behavior:** `execute_done_script()` runs the configured script when a feature has a done_script set.
- Given a feature with `done_script="deploy"` and a scripts.json containing a script with `id: "deploy"`, calling `execute_done_script(feature, config)` should invoke `run_script()` with the matching ScriptConfig.
- The script should be run in a background daemon thread (fire-and-forget).

**Behavior:** `execute_done_script()` does nothing when no done_script is configured.
- Given a feature with `done_script=""`, calling `execute_done_script(feature, config)` should return immediately without calling `run_script()` or spawning any threads.

**Behavior:** `execute_done_script()` handles missing scripts gracefully.
- Given a feature with `done_script="deleted-script"` but scripts.json has no entry with that ID, calling `execute_done_script()` should log a warning and return without error.

**Behavior:** `execute_done_script()` handles script execution errors without propagating.
- If `run_script()` raises an exception, the error should be logged but not propagated to the caller.

**Behavior:** Context string is passed to the script.
- When `execute_done_script()` calls `run_script()`, the context parameter should contain the feature's item_type and title (e.g., "Triggered by completion of feature: My Feature").

### 1.3 CLI Integration — done() command (pipeline.py)

**Behavior:** The `pipeline done` command triggers script execution after moving to done stage.
- Run `pipeline done <feature_id>` on a feature in final-human-approval that has `done_script="my-script"`. After the feature is moved to done, `execute_done_script()` should be called.
- The done command should complete successfully even if `execute_done_script()` raises an exception (error is caught and displayed as warning).

**Behavior:** The done command works normally when no done_script is set.
- Run `pipeline done <feature_id>` on a feature without done_script. The command should complete normally, same as before this feature was added.

### 1.4 TUI Integration — Promote/Approve to Done (tui.py)

**Behavior:** `action_promote()` triggers script execution when promoting to done.
- When a feature in final-human-approval is promoted via `action_promote()`, and it has a done_script set, `execute_done_script()` should be called after the move.
- If `execute_done_script()` fails, the promotion to done should still succeed and the user should see a warning notification.

**Behavior:** `action_approve()` triggers script execution when approving to done.
- When a feature in final-human-approval is approved via `action_approve()` and has a done_script set, `execute_done_script()` should be called.
- Failures in script execution should not prevent the approval.

**Behavior:** `_on_move_requested()` triggers script execution when server requests move to done.
- When the server sends a move request to stage "done" for a feature with done_script set, `execute_done_script()` should be called after the move.
- This should only trigger when target_stage is "done", not for moves to other stages.

### 1.5 TUI Display — done_script in Feature Views (tui.py)

**Behavior:** Feature detail view shows the done script label when set.
- When viewing a feature with `done_script="deploy"` and scripts.json has a script with `id: "deploy", label: "Deploy to Production"`, the detail view should display "Done Script: Deploy to Production".
- When the script ID exists in the feature but has been deleted from scripts.json, display "[MISSING] deploy".
- When no done_script is set, no done script line should appear in the detail view.

**Behavior:** Feature markdown header includes done_script info when set.
- When generating feature markdown for a feature with done_script set, the header should include the done_script information.

### 1.6 TUI Feature Creation — done_script Selection (tui.py)

**Behavior:** The new feature creation flow offers script selection.
- When creating a new feature via the TUI, after selecting item type, the user should be presented with a list of available scripts plus a "(none)" option.
- Selecting "(none)" should create the feature with `done_script=""`.
- Selecting a script should create the feature with `done_script` set to that script's ID.
- If no scripts are defined in scripts.json, this step should either be skipped or only show "(none)".

### 1.7 TUI Feature Editing — done_script (tui.py)

**Behavior:** Users can edit the done_script of an existing feature.
- The feature action/edit menu should include an option to edit the done script.
- Selecting it shows available scripts plus "(none)" with the current selection indicated.
- Changing the selection updates the feature's done_script and persists to disk.

### 1.8 Server State Push — done_script in Feature Summaries (server_client.py)

**Behavior:** Feature summaries sent to the server include the done_script field.
- When `push_state()` builds feature summaries, each summary should include `"done_script": "<value>"` where value is the feature's done_script (empty string if not set).

### 1.9 Go Server — DoneScript in FeatureSummary Struct (hub.go)

**Behavior:** The FeatureSummary struct includes a DoneScript field.
- The struct should have `DoneScript string \`json:"done_script,omitempty"\`` field.
- Feature data received from clients should correctly deserialize the done_script field.
- Feature data served to web UI clients should include done_script.

### 1.10 Web UI — done_script Display and Editing (templates, api.go)

**Behavior:** Feature cards in the web UI show a visual indicator when done_script is set.
- Features with a done_script should display a badge/label showing the script name.
- Features without done_script should show no indicator.

**Behavior:** The idea creation form includes done_script selection.
- The creation form should have a dropdown/select for done_script with available scripts.
- Creating an idea with a selected script should pass done_script through to feature creation.

**Behavior:** The web UI allows editing done_script on existing features.
- An edit control should be available to change the done_script.
- Changes should be sent via the server to the pipeline client and persisted.

### 1.11 Scripts API Endpoint (api.go)

**Behavior:** An API endpoint serves the list of available scripts.
- GET request to the scripts endpoint should return a JSON array of available scripts with id and label.

## 2. Edge Cases

### 2.1 Empty/Null Inputs
- Feature created with `done_script=None` — should be treated as empty string.
- Feature JSON file on disk has no `done_script` key at all (legacy feature) — `done_script` property should return `""`.
- `set_done_script(None)` — should either set to empty string or handle gracefully.

### 2.2 Boundary Conditions
- Feature with done_script is moved to done from a stage other than final-human-approval (e.g., via CLI with warning) — script should still execute.
- Feature with done_script is moved to a stage OTHER than done (e.g., rejected) — script should NOT execute.
- Scripts.json is empty array `[]` — script selection should show only "(none)" option, execute_done_script should handle gracefully.
- Scripts.json file does not exist — should behave same as empty array.

### 2.3 Invalid States
- Feature has `done_script` set to a script ID that contains invalid characters — validation should warn but the value can still be stored.
- Scripts.json is malformed JSON — `load_scripts()` returns empty list, `execute_done_script()` logs warning about missing script.
- Feature's done_script references a script that existed at creation time but was later removed from scripts.json — execution should log a warning and continue without error.

### 2.4 Concurrent Operations
- Multiple features complete simultaneously with different done scripts — each should spawn its own background thread without interference.
- A feature is moved to done while another feature's done script is still running — both should work independently.
- Background done script thread should not block the main pipeline or TUI event loop.

### 2.5 Error Conditions
- `run_script()` raises an exception during execution — error should be logged, caller should not see the error.
- `load_scripts()` fails (e.g., permission error reading scripts.json) — should be handled gracefully, logged as warning.
- Feature file cannot be read during script execution (e.g., deleted between trigger and execution) — background thread should handle gracefully.
- `execute_done_script()` itself raises an unexpected exception — callers (CLI done, TUI promote/approve, server move) should all catch it and continue.

## 3. What Constitutes Failure

### 3.1 Critical Failures (must never happen)
- The `pipeline done` command fails or exits with error because of done_script execution failure.
- TUI crashes or hangs when a done script fails.
- Server move to done fails because of done script issues.
- Feature is NOT moved to done stage because the script failed.
- Main thread or TUI event loop blocks waiting for done script to complete.
- Legacy features (without done_script field in JSON) cause errors when loaded.

### 3.2 Functional Failures
- `done_script` value is not persisted to JSON file after `set_done_script()` call.
- `execute_done_script()` is not called in any of the three done paths (CLI, TUI promote, TUI approve).
- `execute_done_script()` is called when target stage is NOT done.
- Script selection is not offered during feature creation in TUI.
- done_script is not displayed in feature detail view when set.
- done_script field is missing from server state push (feature summaries).
- Web UI does not display done_script information.

### 3.3 Expected Error Messages
- When script ID not found at execution time: warning log containing the script ID and indicating it was not found.
- When script execution fails: error log containing the script ID, feature ID, and the error message.
- When CLI done script fails: yellow warning message printed to console.
- When TUI done script fails: warning notification in TUI.

### 3.4 Rollback Behavior
- There is no rollback. If the done script fails, the feature remains in done stage. The script failure is fire-and-forget — it does not affect the feature's state.

## 4. Out of Scope

- **UI timing/animation**: How quickly the script selection dropdown appears, animation transitions, etc.
- **Visual assertions**: Exact pixel-level layout, colors, font sizes of done_script badges in web UI.
- **Performance benchmarks**: How fast scripts execute, thread creation overhead, etc.
- **Script content testing**: Whether the actual commands in scripts.json work correctly — that's the script author's responsibility.
- **Network failure handling**: WebSocket disconnections during done_script editing from web UI.
- **Browser compatibility**: Whether the web UI done_script controls work across different browsers.
- **Thread cleanup on process exit**: Daemon threads will be killed on process exit by design.
- **Mobile-specific layout testing**: Whether script dropdowns overflow on specific screen sizes (general responsiveness is covered but not device-specific testing).
- **Load testing**: Behavior under hundreds of concurrent done script executions.
- **Script timeout handling**: No timeout is specified in the plan, so scripts run until completion or error.
- **Authentication/authorization**: Who can edit done_script values — follows existing feature edit permissions.

plan_reviews.summary: Plan is incomplete - missing trigger point in pipeline.py, no support for editing completion_script after creation, and web UI move to done is not handled.
plan_reviews.feedback:
MISSING TRIGGER POINT: The plan only mentions two locations in tui.py (~lines 2326 and 2536) but misses pipeline/pipeline.py:294 where items are also moved to 'done'. This needs script execution logic added.

EDIT AFTER CREATION: Users will need to change the completion_script after initial creation. Plan only covers creation-time selection. Need to add:
   - New message type (e.g., 'edit_completion_script') in server_client.py
   - Handler in tui.py to update the script on existing features
   - UI in both web and TUI to edit the completion_script on existing features

WEB UI MOVE TO DONE: Items can be moved to 'done' via the /api/clients/{id}/features/{id}/move REST endpoint (serveMoveFeature in api.go). When target_stage is 'done', the script must execute. This requires the TUI to handle move_feature messages that target 'done' and trigger the completion script.

FEATURE DISPLAY: No mention of displaying the configured completion_script in feature cards or detail views so users know which script is set.

API STRUCTURE: The plan updates createIdeaData but doesn't address whether there's an update API for features. Currently there's only create and move - an update mechanism needs to be added or the existing edit flow extended.

VALIDATION CONCERNS: Plan mentions validating script ID exists, but doesn't specify what happens if the script is deleted after being assigned to an item - should the item still allow completion or fail gracefully?

plan_reviews.summary: Plan has good structure but needs fixes: naming inconsistency (completion_script vs done_script), missing confirm:true bypass logic, and line number discrepancies. Should explicitly reference the existing design_ref pattern as a model.
plan_reviews.feedback:
Naming: Use 'done_script' instead of 'completion_script' to match codebase patterns (like 'design_ref').

Missing confirm:true logic: The description says this pre-authorizes scripts with 'confirm: true', but the plan doesn't explain how to bypass the confirmation. Need to modify scripts.py or add a 'force' parameter to run_script().

Line numbers: Verify actual line numbers - _on_move_requested is at ~1799, not 1783. Mark_done trigger in pipeline.py is at ~line 294 but verify.

Reference design_ref pattern: The existing design_ref→update_design_doc() is the perfect model. Make this explicit in the plan.

API endpoint path: Verify /api/clients/{id}/features/{id}/completion-script follows existing REST patterns in api.go.

Add trigger point verification: The plan says 4 trigger points but codebase shows 3 main ones (pipeline.py:done command, tui.py:action_approve, tui.py:action_promote). The web UI _on_move_requested is the 4th but needs verification.

Scripts.json reload: Add detail on how UI refreshes script list when scripts.json changes (file watcher or manual refresh).

plan_reviews.summary: Plan has good structure and follows existing patterns, but has gaps in edge cases, missing test strategy, and incomplete async handling details.
plan_reviews.feedback:
Major issues to address:

Missing Test Strategy: No mention of how to test the feature - unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests?

Bulk Operations Not Addressed: What happens when multiple features are moved to 'done' simultaneously (e.g., bulk API operations)? The plan only covers single-feature transitions.

Script Timeout Handling: Long-running scripts have no timeout. Add timeout parameter to run_script with configurable default.

Undo/Redo Edge Case: If a feature moves from 'done' back to a previous stage, then back to 'done' again - should the done_script re-run? Current plan doesn't clarify.

TUI Async Lifecycle: Using asyncio.create_task() without addressing cleanup when app closes. Scripts could be killed mid-execution.

Script Output Visibility: Users need to see script execution results/output. How is this presented in TUI and Web UI?

API Bulk Endpoint: Plan mentions single-feature API endpoint but not bulk update endpoint for done_script.

Security Review for bypass_confirm: The bypass_confirm flag allows skipping confirmation. Ensure this is properly scoped and logged for audit trail.

Missing Migration Strategy: How to handle existing features - should done_script default to empty string?

Database Schema: If using a database, is migration needed for the done_script field?

Minor issues:
No mention of documentation updates
No rollback strategy if script fails mid-execution
Rate limiting mentioned but not specific implementation details

plan_reviews.summary: The plan has several feasibility issues and missing details: (1) ScriptConfig lacks bypass_confirm field referenced in plan, (2) run_script() timeout implementation is unclear since it uses AgentRunner, (3) No existing rate limiting infrastructure exists, (4) Missing UI for editing done_script on existing features, (5) No handling for when script_id doesn't exist in scripts.json.
plan_reviews.feedback:
Issues to fix:

ScriptConfig missing bypass_confirm: The plan references bypass_confirm=True but pipeline/scripts.py ScriptConfig dataclass (lines 18-27) doesn't have this field. Add bypass_confirm field to ScriptConfig.

Timeout implementation unclear: The plan says 'extend existing run_script() function with timeout parameter' but run_script() uses AgentRunner (line 111 in scripts.py), not a subprocess. Timeout concept needs clarification - either add timeout to AgentRunner.headless() or implement process tracking with time limits.

Rate limiting infrastructure missing: Plan mentions 'max 5 concurrent script executions' but there's no existing rate limiting mechanism. This requires implementing a semaphore-based queue from scratch.

Missing editing UI: Plan covers done_script selection in feature creation modal but doesn't address editing done_script on existing features. Need UI for PATCH /api/features/{id} endpoint usage.

Script validation missing: What happens when done_script references a script_id that doesn't exist in scripts.json? Plan should explicitly handle this error case (log error, skip execution, don't fail the stage transition).

WebSocket notification gap: When done_script is updated via PATCH, connected TUI clients need to receive the update. Plan should clarify how state sync happens after done_script field changes.

Missing DoneScript in FeatureSummary: The plan adds DoneScript to FeatureSummary struct but doesn't verify it's included in the server_client.py push_state() payload.

TUI async lifecycle: The plan mentions 'track running script tasks in TUI app state' and 'graceful shutdown' but doesn't detail the implementation - need to store ScriptStatus objects and handle app exit cleanup.

plan_reviews.summary: The plan has several technical issues: 1) Uses deprecated asyncio.get_event_loop() instead of asyncio.get_running_loop(), 2) Missing error handling strategy for script failures (should feature still be marked done?), 3) Server API implementation via subprocess is complex and may not work if TUI is not running, 4) No verification that script exists when saving done_script to feature.

Asyncio deprecation (tui.py): Line 85 uses asyncio.get_event_loop() which is deprecated in Python 3.10+. Change to asyncio.get_running_loop().

No-op when done_script is empty

impl_reviews.summary: Critical bug: duplicate STAGE_ACTIONS in tui.py (lines 1427-1439 vs 1442-1456) — second definition overrides the first, removing all 'edit_done_script' actions from the TUI. Also, execute_done_script tests have race conditions due to asserting on background thread calls without joining.
impl_reviews.feedback:
Critical Issues

Duplicate STAGE_ACTIONS overrides done_script editing (tui.py)

The class has TWO STAGE_ACTIONS definitions:
Lines 1427-1439: includes ("e", "edit_done_script", "Edit Script") in every stage
Lines 1442-1456: does NOT include edit_done_script in any stage

Since Python class attributes are set sequentially, the second definition (without edit_done_script) completely overrides the first. This means the 'e' key binding for editing done scripts is NOT available in any stage. The action_edit_done_script method exists but is unreachable via stage actions.

Fix: Remove the second STAGE_ACTIONS definition (lines 1442-1456) entirely, keeping only the first one that includes the edit_done_script actions.

Race conditions in execute_done_script tests (test_scripts.py)

test_execute_done_script_calls_run_script and test_execute_done_script_handles_run_script_exception both call execute_done_script() which spawns a daemon thread, then immediately assert mock_run_script.assert_called_once(). The thread may not have executed run_script() yet when the assertion runs. These tests pass by luck due to scheduling timing but are technically racy.

Fix: Add import time; time.sleep(0.1) or thread.join(timeout=1) before assertions. Alternatively, refactor execute_done_script to return the thread so tests can join it, or make threading optional for testability.

Minor Issues

pipeline.py line 194 has orphaned code

Line 194 has an orphaned line: console.print(f"[dim]Run the pipeline with: pipeline run {feature.slug}[/dim]") that appears to be left over from a removed approve command. This is a pre-existing issue but worth noting.
